itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The two FORM pages (p3 Schedule A, p8 Schedule B) carry only 'See Attached' and leave SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE empty, printing only the grand TOTAL - so neither form page gates per-page. The attachments print ONE grand total each (no per-page subtotals), so the gate is applied at the whole-side level and BOTH PASS EXACTLY: 202 contribution rows = $51,558.02 printed; 61 expenditure rows = $69,447.68 printed. Because pages 4-7 and 9-10 print no per-page subtotal, no individual attachment page can gate on its own - the exact whole-side agreement across 263 rows is the strongest available check and it holds to the cent.

itemized.notes: Sim Gill, Salt Lake County District Attorney (Democrat), September 15 interim, signed 9/15/14, clerk-stamped SEP 15 2014. The largest filing in this chunk: 202 itemized contributions and 61 itemized expenditures. Pages 3 and 8 are the printed Schedule A / Schedule B forms carrying only 'See Attached'; the itemization lives on born-digital spreadsheet printouts. Pages 4-7 (contributions) are LANDSCAPE, rotated 90 degrees COUNTER-CLOCKWISE on the portrait page (PIL rotate(+90) is the correct sign for this file - the opposite of the Bruner filing in this same chunk); pages 9-10 (expenditures) are upright portrait. GEOMETRY NOTE: the contribution row pointers are expressed in the PORTRAIT page frame as poppler renders it, so each band is a narrow VERTICAL strip (small w, large h); the expenditure pointers are ordinary horizontal bands. PRIVACY: the contributions attachment carries a full street-address column that the COUNTY has redacted with a solid black bar on every page; the City / State / Zip columns to the right of the bar are legible, so donor_city/donor_state are recorded and no street address was read or written. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: because the address redaction physically splits each landscape page, the left half (Date/First/Last) and right half (City/State/Zip/Occupation/Employer/Amount) had to be read as separate images and re-joined by row order. The screen passed on all four pages - the row COUNTS match exactly per page (54/55/55/38 = 54/55/55/38) and the join is independently corroborated by ten content anchors: seven Lisa Ashman rows landing on the seven 'Admin Assistant / Salt Lake County' in-kind lines, Joann Seghini on 'Mayor / Midvale City', Rebecca Chavez-Houck on 'Representative / State of Utah', Carlton Christensen on 'Regional Development Director / Salt Lake County', Frank Nakamura on 'Attorney / Murray City', William Bohling on 'Mediator / Bohling Mediation', Peter Dreissig on 'Henderson NV / Allegiant Air', Operating Engineers Local 3 on 'Alameda CA', Southwest Regional Council of Carpenters on 'Sacramento CA', and the two 'Miscellaneous Cash Contributions' aggregate rows on the only two blank-geography lines. NAME COMPOSITION: donor_raw is the printed First Name cell plus the Last Name cell; where Last Name is empty the First Name cell holds a whole organization name (Utah AFL-CIO x3, Winder & Counsel, Progressive Caucus, Operating Engineers Local 3, Southwest Regional Council of Carpenters, Lundell & Lofgren, IBEW PAC Educational Fund, Love Communications) and is used verbatim. Several rows are joint donors printed as one line ('Ethel Hale & Paul Wharton'), kept as printed and never split. TWO AGGREGATE ROWS ('Miscellaneous Cash Contributions', $20.00 on p4 and $55.00 on p7) are transcribed as aggregate rows with needs_review=1, never resolved to persons. CLIPPED CELLS: five city cells are cut off by the spreadsheet's column width on the page itself ('Mountain Gree', 'North Salt Lak' x2, 'Cottonwood H' x2) and one donor name ('Operating Engineers Local 3 - District 12 PA'); all are recorded at the legible string with needs_review=1 and were NOT completed - the missing characters are not on the page and no higher dpi recovers them. FILER INCONSISTENCIES retained, not reconciled: (a) Lisa Ashman contributed $149.66 in kind on BOTH 6/27 and 6/28 while only one $149.66 expenditure exists; (b) the $46.17 Costco parade-supplies expenditure is not flagged In Kind although its matching contribution is; (c) the $250.00 Scott Mietchen fundraiser expenditure is not flagged In Kind although its matching contribution is. Love Communications appears on BOTH sides - a $1,250.00 contribution and $38,652.93 of billings across four expenditure rows.
